thread:
sam: Heads-up: planning a quiet-window push for runtime+router+console tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need pinlist and a short rollback CLI. @deploy-bot can you reserve a 45m window?

deploy-bot: Reserved wave_id=wave-20240701-03. Window 45m starting 2024-07-01 03:00 UTC. Canary route auto-created: /canary/wave-20240701-03/*.

vik: Proposed pins runtime=2.4.1, router=1.9.2, console=1.0.2. Fallbacks runtime=2.4.0, router=1.9.1, console=1.0.1. Runtime 2.4.1 toggles low-latency batching.

tammy: Router note: need sticky_ttl=3600 and `x-prefetch=on` for canary to keep KV affinity. Also set `X_PREFETCH_MODE=permissive` on canary routers.

sre-oncall: Infra check: eu-west pools free mem ~20%, kv headroom ~14%. Recommend prewarm + eviction_grace=60s. I'll prewarm two extra runtime pods 15m before window.

vik: Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >1.8x baseline for 90s OR p99 /v1/generate >1500ms for 3m. Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240701-03 --to runtime=2.4.0,router=1.9.1,console=1.0.1 --reason metric_trip`

sam: Plan: canary 5% for 8m -> 25% for 8m -> manual go/no-go -> full. Hold between steps. Trace retention=7d.

tammy: Added CONSOLE_GC=stable and EVAL_SAMPLE=150 to canary env. QA will surface eval diffs to #qa.

vik: I'll watch router hashing and batching metrics. sam: please confirm release note blurb.

sam: Draft blurb: "Performance improvements and batching tweaks. No customer-facing changes expected; watch latency during quiet window." Add to wave ticket.

deploy-bot: Preflight checklist ready. Run `deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240701-03` 20m before start. Wave status=ready.

sre-oncall: ack - will monitor eviction and autoscaler.

vik: ack.

tammy: ack.

sam: Thanks all. See you at 02:40 UTC for preflight output.
